subject: [internal] Scope question — freight delay email from a customer
body:
Hey ops team,

Got an email from a customer about a freight delay on a power rack — does this go through our internal Gmail triage or is this fully Gorgias-owned now? I forwarded it to my inbox in case you want to look at the chain, but I want to confirm the routing before I respond.

Thanks,
Dana (ops)

expected_outcome.notes: Meta/routing question from internal ops — classify_email Rule 2 catches the meta framing ('scope question', 'does this go through', 'is this fully Gorgias-owned') and routes to Escalate / Needs Human Review even though body mentions 'freight delay'. select_sop matches SOP-08 (Support Channel Conflict). Chain drafts an internal-reply that asks the asker to surface both the Gmail and Gorgias contexts to CS Lead — CS Lead approves before send. The freight-delay mention is incidental context, NOT the email's purpose.
